notes: Curated 2026-10-18. CLI framework (776 files); no AI SDK, model id, or AI package.
Adversarial for prompts: docs_src/prompt/ and docs_src/options/prompt/ are
directories of *terminal prompt* tutorials (typer.prompt), not LLM prompts.
typer/.agents/skills/typer/SKILL.md is shipped instruction text for external
coding agents; Typer itself never sends it to a model, so it is not counted
as an application prompt. A reviewer may reasonably disagree; recorded here.
